scope: Synthetic calendar-state fixtures only. All labels are non-market placeholders and no fixture is an input row.

cases.reason: A scheduled record alone is not an actual-publication record and cannot authorize a post-release classification.
Without a documented daylight-saving determination and ET-to-JST rule, conversion is ambiguous and must not be inferred.
A cancellation, holiday conflict, or emergency change without a documented actual replacement timestamp yields no event.
The fixture isolates timing: a later revision cannot create a new event timestamp; absent a documented original timestamp, the broader rule remains fail-closed.
An event outside the applicable OSE session, or one whose session membership is not established, does not create a session-eligible event.
Without a documented actual timestamp, neither scheduled metadata nor a later archive reference is substituted.
